entry.insight: Three short sentences carry the whole Reformed doctrine of the cross. In the place of, instead of, on behalf of: Christ took the obligation that was ours and discharged it.

entry.text: As, however, the effects produced transcend the efficiency of our fallen nature, and are due to the agency of the Spirit, sanctification does not cease to be supernatural, or a work of grace, because the soul is active and cooperating in the process.
